review: 300.2a-1: Dryad Arbor has no mana cost, so the base 'cannot cast' was also explained by 118.6 and did not isolate 300.2a; added Omniscience (free casting of nonland cards) to remove that confound, replaced the Forests, added a Llanowar Elves does_not_fire variant and made play_as_land the 'other' branch.

300.2: triaged definitional, but 'subject to spells and abilities that affect either card type' is an observable targeting verdict; reclassified as legality/direct/playability and added scenario 300.2-1 (Shatter targeting Ornithopter vs Grizzly Bears).

scenarios.title: A land that is also a creature can only be played as a land, never cast

setup.notes: A has not played a land this turn. Omniscience lets A cast nonland spells from hand without paying their mana costs, so Dryad Arbor's lack of a mana cost (118.6) is not what stops a cast; only 300.2a is.

decisions: A attempts to cast Dryad Arbor as a spell, using Omniscience's permission.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting Dryad Arbor is not legal: can_play is false for the cast action. Dryad Arbor stays in A's hand and the stack stays empty.

variants.label: nonland_creature
variants.delta: The card in A's hand is Llanowar Elves (a creature that is not a land) instead of Dryad Arbor.
variants.expected: Casting Llanowar Elves without paying its mana cost is legal: can_play is true.

variants.label: play_as_land
variants.delta: A plays Dryad Arbor as a land instead of attempting to cast it.
variants.expected: Playing Dryad Arbor as a land is legal. It does not use the stack and enters the battlefield under A's control as a 1/1 green land creature.

scenarios.title: An artifact creature is subject to spells that affect artifacts

setup.notes: Ornithopter is an Artifact Creature. No other artifact is on the battlefield.

decisions: A attempts to cast Shatter targeting Ornithopter, tapping both Mountains.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Ornithopter is a legal target for Shatter: has_legal_target is true and can_play is true.

variants.label: nonartifact_creature
variants.delta: B's creature is Grizzly Bears (a creature that is not an artifact) instead of Ornithopter.
variants.expected: Shatter has no legal target: has_legal_target is false and can_play is false.
